scope: Published official docs and public endpoint metadata; no account creation, key validation, authenticated catalog, inference, or signup tests. Group dispositions cover all 100 original entry numbers; they do not certify every original model ID or specification. This is research data, not runtime configuration.

original_groups.decision: Keep as free-tier candidates, not unlimited/permanent promises. Standard input/output pricing is free for the listed Gemini Flash/Flash-Lite/2.5 Pro and hosted Gemma 4 families. Quotas vary by project and model; the blanket 15 RPM / 1,500 RPD claim is not verified. Gemma hosted IDs are gemma-4-31b-it and gemma-4-26b-a4b-it. Do not generalize context/output caps across families.
original_groups.verification_scope: Pricing/model-family docs and lifecycle; no authenticated account/catalog or inference test.

original_groups.decision: Replace the entire supplied Groq roster. Llama 3.3 70B versatile and Llama 3.1 8B instant ended Free/Developer support on 2026-08-16 (Enterprise is separate); the other ten listed IDs have earlier retirement notices. Use the current GPT-OSS models; Qwen 3.8 27B is a preview candidate.
original_groups.verification_scope: Official deprecation notices and current catalog; no key or inference test.

original_groups.decision: Keep provider, not a blanket approval of all twenty IDs. 10,000 neurons/day is a shared account allowance, resetting at 00:00 UTC; Workers Free stops at its limit, Workers Paid can charge excess. Some models require Workers Paid. Check individual model eligibility. #40–42 are image/speech/embedding specialists, not text reviewers. Legacy/LoRA entries need exact catalog and protocol checks.
original_groups.verification_scope: Provider pricing/limits and current catalog; not every original model has a completed per-model eligibility check.

original_groups.decision: Exclude from the recurring-free default pool. Hosted API access is described in terms of trial API credits; the claimed renewing 1,000 calls/month was not established. Open weights or self-hosting do not make NVIDIA-hosted inference free.
original_groups.verification_scope: Provider-level terms; individual supplied model IDs not all revalidated.

original_groups.decision: Exclude. Official FAQ explicitly says no permanently renewing free tier: $5 credits, expire after 30 days, verified payment method required; API stays inactive without it. The current shared catalog lists gpt-oss-120b and qwen-3.8-27b rather than the four supplied IDs. Trial quotas of 1M TPD do not make it an always-free plan.
original_groups.verification_scope: Current model overview and explicit trial FAQ.

original_groups.decision: Keep only as a separately labelled credit-funded free-plan option: Free mode has no-card API access and $10/month API credits. This contradicts the list header’s no-credits/unlimited promise. Keep PAYG off. #57 calls an 8B model by the 3B ID duplicated at #59; documented 8B version is ministral-8b-2512. latest aliases are not fixed version/parameter guarantees.
original_groups.verification_scope: Current pricing/signup/subscription docs and model overview; not every supplied alias authenticated.

original_groups.decision: Separate evaluation-only pool, not default production-free inference. Trial keys are documented at 1,000 calls/month. Newer Command models exist, but evaluation access does not imply production entitlement; confirm each exact model/account.
original_groups.verification_scope: Provider key/limits terms plus current catalog; no production entitlement test.

original_groups.decision: All nine supplied IDs returned metadata with endpoints: [] from their public endpoint APIs during this audit. Do not mark them ready on that evidence. This is a dated public discovery observation, not an authenticated inference test or proof of permanent removal. No-purchase free-model limit is 50 requests/day and up to 20/minute; 1,000/day is purchase-dependent. Free variant must really exist and have explicit zero pricing.
original_groups.verification_scope: Nine public model-endpoint JSON responses, plus official free-variant and quota docs.

original_groups.decision: The four IDs are documented, but their model table lists nonzero token prices. A Free rate-limit tier (15 RPM, 20K TPM/TPD) is not sufficient proof that inference is unbilled. Hold out of the guaranteed-zero-cost pool until billing entitlement is documented.
original_groups.verification_scope: Model pricing and rate-limit pages; unresolved billing semantics.

original_groups.decision: China docs describe GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash as free. China GLM-4.5-Flash notice says retirement on 2026-01-30 and automatic routing to 4.7, not retiring soon. International Z.AI pricing separately lists all three Flash models as free. Do not interchange keys/endpoints or count a redirect as another model. Paid tools are excluded.
original_groups.verification_scope: Both realm-specific pricing/model docs; no account or inference test.

original_groups.decision: Remove from API-free count. Free consumer chat does not grant free developer API inference; the official API pricing is token-billed.
original_groups.verification_scope: Provider API pricing; no signup or web automation test.

original_groups.decision: Hold out of recurring-free pool. Official introduction requires a valid API key and available credit; no renewing zero-cost allowance for the supplied IDs was established.
original_groups.verification_scope: Provider-level docs, not a complete individual-model catalog audit.

original_groups.decision: Free users receive $0.10 monthly credits, subject to change. This is not unlimited serverless LLM inference. A Hub model repository does not establish an available hosted provider route or free entitlement. Keep separate from zero-priced models.
original_groups.verification_scope: Provider credit policy; individual hosted routes remain to be checked.

original_groups.decision: Exclude from unconditional $0 pool. API uses purchased credits, staking-linked allowance or per-request payment. A consumer default selection is not a verified concrete model ID.
original_groups.verification_scope: Official API funding overview; supplied alias not validated.

original_groups.decision: Exclude from supported API-key pool. These were supplied as unofficial/no-key consumer-chat endpoints, not documented developer API offerings. The fetched help URL resolved to general consumer content, not an API contract. No endpoint bypass or scraping tested.
original_groups.verification_scope: No official developer API evidence obtained; do not interpret this as proof no future API can exist.
